pages.title: Salvaged Power Cells
pages.text: Part-charged cells left at ORSA sites: $(bold)100-300 kJ$() each.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: $(li)Cargo drops$(li)Monitoring stations$(li)Abandoned evacuation vehicles$(li)Camp equipment crates$(br2)Caches you already looted stay empty.

pages.title: Using Them
pages.text: Put one in a $(l:power/storage)Cell Dock$(/l) and link a lamp or machine. No Core needed.$(br2)A dock can't recharge it. Recharge in a Battery Bank with spare power; carry empties home.
